title: Learn how to control the Unity Editor through the official Unity Model Context Protocol (MCP) 🤝

author: Unity
description:
Unity AI is now in open beta. In this video, you’ll learn how to use the Unity Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI agents to interact directly with the Unity Editor. 

Unity MCP lets the Unity Editor act as a server, exposing built-in tools such as scene management, script editing, and console access to third party AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Visual Code Copilot, and more. Your third-party AI agent can interact directly with Unity to speed up your workflows.

You’ll also learn how to configure Unity MCP to work with supported tools. 

🔗 To learn more and sign up for the Unity AI Open Beta, check out: https://on.unity.com/3QJgAY2

👉 More details in our Unity AI documentation: https://on.unity.com/4ukSqS5
